messages.author: 35651167c032511e
messages.subject: favicon icon?
parts:
Hi there,

it is surely a good sign for the quality of a software (shiny, that is, since we  as normal R / shiny users don't have to do a lot to design great UIs ...), when everything that is left to request by users is an individual favicon ;-)

Is it possible to set one for a shiny app?

-Christoph

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: favicon icon?
parts:
If you're using a local runapp, then putting one in <appdir>/www/favicon.ico should work, I believe.

You could also insert this somewhere in your UI:

tags$head(tags$link(rel="shortcut icon", href="URL-to-favicon"))
